Class ServerController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.controller.ServerController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerControllerInterface
public class ServerController extends Object implements ServerControllerInterface
Server controller that manages game lobbies, player connections, and game sessions. Handles player registration, lobby creation, player joining/leaving, and disconnections. Acts as an intermediary between the client handlers and the game model.

  • Method Details

    • registerNickname

      public void registerNickname(String nickname, ClientHandler clientHandler)
      Registers a player with the given nickname and associates it with the provided client handler. Sends the player information about the active lobbies he can join. If the player is already registered but not active, it reconnects the player and generates a snapshot of the game they are in.

      Calls Player.addPlayer(String) to add a new player

      Specified by:
      registerNickname in interface ServerControllerInterface
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player to register
      clientHandler - the client handler associated with the player

    • newGame

      public LobbyInterface newGame(Player creator, Level level, int numPlayers)
      Creates a new lobby for a game of the chosen level and with the specified number of players, adding the creator to it

      The lobby is created with the ServerController demoMode and editScenario parameters

      Specified by:
      newGame in interface ServerControllerInterface
      Parameters:
      creator - nickname of the lobby creator
      level - level of the game
      numPlayers - number of players in the game
      Returns:
      the LobbyInterface of the created lobby
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the player is already in a lobby
